question: If the area of an equilateral triangle is 16√3 cm², then find its perimeter.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, side a = √(Area × 4 ÷ √3).

Given Area = 16√3 cm².

Side a = √(16√3 × 4 ÷ √3) = √64 = 8 cm.

Perimeter = 3 × a = 3 × 8 = 24 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of an equilateral triangle = 16√3 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

Perimeter of equilateral triangle = 3 × a

 
 A B C a a a Area = 16√3 sq. cm 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

⇒ 16√3 = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

⇒ a² = (16√3 × 4) ÷ √3

⇒ a² = 16 × 4

⇒ a² = 64

⇒ a = √64 = 8 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 3 × a

⇒ Perimeter = 3 × 8 = 24 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Height of Equilateral Triangle

Altitude (h) = (√3 ÷ 2) × a, where a is the side of the triangle.

Inradius & Circumradius

Inradius (r) = a ÷ (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a ÷ √3. Relation: R = 2r.

Area of Isosceles Triangle

Area = (b ÷ 4) × √(4a² − b²), where a is the length of equal sides and b is the base.
